pr.title: Parameterise user search and read the fraud API key from the environment

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+package clients
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"os"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// Client talks to the fraud-scoring service. The API key is injected by the
+// deployment environment; it is never checked into the repository.
+type Client struct {
+	APIKey  string
+	BaseURL string
+	HTTP    *http.Client
+}
+
+func newClient() *Client {
+	return &Client{
+		APIKey:  os.Getenv("API_KEY"),
+		BaseURL: "https://fraud.internal.acme.example",
+		HTTP:    &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second},
+	}
+}
